verification_program:
"""Record an actual new kernel execution after a specific reviewed repair."""

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
lesson, name, scope = sys.argv[1:]
row = next(item for item in json.loads((ROOT / "course/lesson-index.json").read_text()) if item["id"] == lesson)
source = ROOT / row["notebook"]
source_hash = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
command = [str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/python"), "scripts/check_notebooks.py", "--mode", "kernel", "--workers", "1", "--lesson", lesson, "--output", "outputs/integration-notebooks"]
started = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
if completed.returncode:
    print(completed.stdout)
    print(completed.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == source_hash
report = json.loads((ROOT / "outputs/integration-notebooks/validation-kernel.json").read_text())
assert report["passed"] == report["total"] == 1 and report["failed"] == 0
output = ROOT / "outputs/integration-notebooks" / Path(row["notebook"]).relative_to("notebooks")
paths = [ROOT / row["source"], source, output]
receipt = {
    "checked_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "started_at": started,
    "scope": scope,
    "lesson": lesson,
    "command": command,
    "returncode": completed.returncode,
    "stdout": completed.stdout,
    "stderr": completed.stderr,
    "report": report,
    "source_sha256": {path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths},
    "verification_program_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "verification_program": Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
destination = ROOT / "docs/validation-artifacts" / name
assert destination.parent == ROOT / "docs/validation-artifacts"
assert not destination.exists(), "Use a new receipt name to preserve execution history"
destination.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"lesson": lesson, "report": report, "receipt": destination.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}))
